meta.notes: RS = Rüstungsschutz (Armor Rating). BE = Behinderung (Encumbrance). Weights in Stein (1 Stein = 1 kg). Prices in Silbertaler. Helmet/limb armor: +RS additive to body armor. Metal armor interferes with arcane magic (see magic_restriction). Source AA (Aventuria Armory) excluded — TDE5 system.

armor.name: Thick Clothing
armor.special: RS does not add to armor worn over it. Includes winter/fur clothing, all-leather wilderness clothing, heavy leather jackets, thick brocade and velvet garments.

armor.name: Quilted Underclothing
armor.special: Required under all metal armor to prevent abrasions. RS and BE do not add to armor worn over it when worn alone.

armor.name: Quilted Surcoat (Gambeson)
armor.special: Two layers of coarse linen stitched with padding. RS and BE add to armor worn over it.

armor.name: Toadskin
armor.special: Vest of thick leather with heavy rivets. EC not added to Swimming or Balance checks. Only RS 2 vs. ranged.

armor.name: Leather Harness
armor.special: Hardened and lacquered leather. Covers more than toadskin. Standard light armor.

armor.name: Studded Leather
armor.special: Leather with metal studs. Higher RS than plain leather. Popular among bandits and mercenaries.

armor.name: Scale Armor
armor.special: Overlapping metal or horn scales sewn to leather backing. RS stacks with quilted underclothing.

armor.name: Chain Hauberk
armor.special: Chain mail shirt. Requires quilted underclothing (BE +1, RS +1 when worn together). Metal: interferes with arcane magic.

armor.name: Full Chain
armor.special: Complete chain mail suit including coif. Requires quilted underclothing. Metal: arcane magic penalty.

armor.name: Half Plate
armor.special: Combination of plate sections and chain. Better protection than full chain, less than full plate. Metal: arcane magic penalty.

armor.name: Plate Cuirass
armor.special: Solid breastplate and backplate only. Worn over quilted surcoat. RS and BE add together. Metal: arcane magic penalty.

armor.name: Three-Quarter Plate
armor.special: Plate covering torso, arms, and thighs. Usually worn with quilted underclothing (+1 RS, +1 BE). Metal: arcane magic penalty.

armor.name: Full Plate
armor.special: Complete plate armor including helm. Must be custom-fitted. Requires quilted underclothing. Metal: arcane magic penalty. Cannot swim.

armor.name: Jousting Armor
armor.special: Specialized tournament plate. Extremely heavy. Only practical on horseback for jousting. Cannot dodge or sprint. Metal: arcane magic penalty.

armor.name: Open Helm
armor.special: +RS only to head. Add to body armor RS for head-hit calculations. No vision restriction.

armor.name: Closed Helm
armor.special: +RS only to head. Reduces vision arc: -1 AT, +1 BE while worn. Muffles hearing: -2 to all perception checks.

armor.name: Great Helm
armor.special: +RS only to head. Severely restricts vision: -2 AT for ranged attacks aimed at head not possible. -3 to all perception checks.

armor.name: Arm Guards
armor.special: +RS to arms only. Add to body armor RS for arm-hit calculations.

armor.name: Leg Guards
armor.special: +RS to legs only. Add to body armor RS for leg-hit calculations.

armor.name: Gauntlets
armor.special: +RS to hands. Unarmed punch damage increases by +1 DP. Fine manipulations: -1 penalty.

armor.name: Brigandine
armor.special: Metal plates riveted inside leather or cloth cover. Less visible than chain. RS and BE stack with quilted underclothing. Metal: arcane magic penalty.

armor.name: Lamellar Armor
armor.special: Horizontal rows of lacquered plates laced together. Eastern Aventuria style. Metal: arcane magic penalty.

armor.name: Coat of Plates
armor.special: Large plates riveted to leather coat covering torso only. Between brigandine and plate cuirass. Metal: arcane magic penalty.
